newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank holds rates steady, markets react calmly.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank holds rates steady, markets react calmly.

text.p: The Bundesbank, Germany's central bank, left its key discount and Lombard rates unchanged at its regular meeting Thursday, in line with the expectations of economists and financial markets.
The discount rate remains at 2.50 percent and the Lombard emergency financing rate at 4.50 percent. The central bank's main money market rate, the repo, was also held steady at 3 percent.
Most economists had not expected any change in the central bank's credit policies this week and German bond and stock markets showed almost no response to the expected move.
